lines.en: label yasuspring2:
scene urbanparadise
I find myself on the way to Yasu’s church (That I very frequently forget the name of) after Touka informs me over the phone that there is going to be a “presentation” of sorts today.
lines.zh: Touka 在电话里告诉我今天会有个什么「宣讲会」，于是我正走在前去 Yasu 教堂的路上（那教堂的名字我老是记不住）。

lines.en: As it turns out, the fliers Yasu handed out all over town (Or attempted to hand out all over town) {i}did{/i} in fact generate some sort of buzz- albeit from other members of the class rather than normal citizens.
lines.zh: 结果看来，Yasu 满镇子发的那些传单（或者说，满镇子试图发出去的传单）{i}确实{/i}掀起了一点波澜——只不过回应的是班里的同学，而不是普通市民。

lines.en: And no, I am not counting the girls of class 1-A as “normal citizens” because, let’s face it, a handful of them are arguably more abnormal than even I am.
lines.zh: 而且，对，我没把 1-A 班的女生算进「普通市民」，因为说实话，她们里头有几个可以说比我还不正常。

lines.en: So as I listen to my footsteps bouncing off of brick buildings down this lengthy concrete hall, I wonder if there is {i}anyone{/i} somewhat “normal” caught in the confines of this place.
lines.zh: 于是，当我听着自己的脚步声在这条长长的水泥走廊两侧的砖楼之间弹回来，我不禁想：被困在这个地方的人里，到底{i}有没有一个{/i}还算「正常」的。

lines.en: I think back to the faceless passersby and where their faces must have gone before realizing that maybe “normal” is just the polite way of saying “boring.”
lines.zh: 我回想起那些没有面孔的路人，想他们的脸究竟去了哪儿，然后意识到——也许「正常」只是「无聊」的客气说法。

lines.en: Maybe those people have some interesting traits mixed in with what’s missing. And maybe what’s missing is a mixture of malice and madness or whatever it is that makes {i}me{/i} more visible than them.
lines.zh: 也许那些人身上也掺着点有趣的特质，混在缺失的东西里。而也许缺失的，正是恶意与疯狂的混合物，或者随便什么让{i}我{/i}比他们更显眼的东西。

lines.en: Whatever it is, I thank my footsteps (As they’re my only current company) for the fact that I am not one of those faceless silhouettes.
lines.zh: 不管那是什么，我感谢自己的脚步声（眼下它们是我唯一的同伴），因为它们提醒我：我不是那些没有脸的剪影之一。

lines.en: But I scorn the necessity of sorrow and open my arms to the possibility of their supposed numbness taking its place. Though, maybe I just haven’t made it to that step yet.
lines.zh: 但我厌恶悲伤的必要性，并张开双臂，迎接他们那种所谓的麻木取而代之的可能性。不过，也许我只是还没走到那一步。

lines.en: Anyway, church. Yasu. Yasu’s church.
lines.zh: 总之，教堂。Yasu。Yasu 的教堂。

lines.en: The place I’m going.
lines.zh: 我要去的地方。

lines.en: The presentation being presented and the presence of the presents she will offer in exchange for my time and my effort — both things better spent on girls with darker hair.
lines.zh: 那场将要被宣讲的宣讲会，以及她为换取我的时间和力气而献上的那些「礼物」——这两样东西，花在头发颜色更深的女孩身上会值当得多。

lines.en: scene black
I wonder who will care enough to show up — or is kind enough to show up — or is bored enough to show up.
lines.zh: 我不禁好奇，谁会在乎到愿意来——或者善良到愿意来——又或者只是无聊到愿意来。

lines.en: Then I wonder how many words it will take for them to realize that all of this is nonsense.
lines.zh: 然后我又好奇，要听多少句话，他们才会意识到这一切全是胡扯。

lines.en: There is no god inside of that building.
lines.zh: 那栋建筑里没有神。

lines.en: They’re all trapped inside of my head.
lines.zh: 它们全被关在我的脑袋里。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation1
: Thank you very much for taking the time out of your days and your lives to experience a taste of mine, however sour it may be.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢各位从你们的日子里、从你们的生命里抽出时间，来尝一尝我的滋味，尽管它可能酸涩难当。

lines.en: : I am Yasu Yasui and I am a divine messenger of the one true God.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Yasu Yasui，是独一真神的神圣使者。

lines.en: : It is my duty to deliver His word unto the people, and to help guide them toward a light they would never be able to find on their own.
lines.zh: : 我的职责是把祂的话语带给人们，并引导他们走向一束光——一束他们靠自己永远找不到的光。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation2
: I’m glad you’re all here...for today is a special day. Or at least I would like to call it one...
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你们都来了……因为今天是个特别的日子。或者说，我想这么称呼它……

lines.en: : But it is not my place to call anywhere anything for any words that {i}I{/i} have to say apart from what are His are vile and filthy and meant to be discarded.
lines.zh: : 但{i}我{/i}没有资格用祂以外的任何言语去称呼任何地方、任何事物，因为我所说的一切都是卑劣的、污秽的，理应被丢弃。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation3

: These doors were meant to stay locked for those who were not chosen...But in {i}my{/i} choosing, they have been opened. And in turn, your unclean bodies have poisoned the air of His great cathedral...
lines.zh: : 这些门本该对未被选中者紧锁……但在{i}我的{/i}选择之下，它们开了。而反过来，你们不洁的躯体也污染了祂伟大教堂里的空气……

lines.en: : But this is...
lines.zh: : 但这是……

lines.en: : This is what has to be done...
lines.zh: : 这是必须做的事……

lines.en: scene yasupresentation4

: It is winter’s great departure and the fading of His voice combined with the presence of another that have spurred me into irrational action! Action that I’d never take without His blessing, of course!
lines.zh: : 是冬天的远去、祂声音的消隐，再加上另一个存在的出现，共同把我推向了不理智的行动！当然是那种没有祂的祝福我绝不会采取的行动！

lines.en: : And shall I be cut down and turned to ribbons for this misdeed, it will have been worth it if such a terrible thing has managed to convey His glory to those I wish would join me in the-
lines.zh: : 就算我要为这桩过错被砍倒、被切成碎条，只要这可怕的东西能把祂的荣光传达给那些我希望与我一同——

lines.en: : {i}Ahem...{/i}
scene yasupresentation5
: A...Anyway...Thank you all for coming...Today I...I plan to share with you some details of...He Who Swallows All...And I will explain to you what steps you may take to begin...earning His favor.
lines.zh: : 呃……总之……谢谢各位到来……今天我……我打算跟各位分享一些关于……吞噬一切者……的细节。我会向各位说明，你们可以走哪些步骤，开始……赢得祂的眷顾。

lines.en: : But...I can not guarantee that your efforts will bear fruit...for He has yet to smile upon all but two of you...
lines.zh: : 但是……我无法保证你们的努力会结出果实……因为祂至今只对你们中的两个人微笑过……

lines.en: : And once more...this is naught more than a selfish act conceived by a selfish girl.
lines.zh: : 再说一次……这不过是一个自私的女孩想出的自私之举。

lines.en: : One who shies away from the dark...yet feels it inching closer and closer to her tainted flesh with each passing storm.
lines.zh: : 一个躲避黑暗的女孩……却感觉黑暗随着每一场风暴的过去，一点点逼近她那被玷污的肉体。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation6
: Well, this is definitely a weird crowd. But also mostly in line with my expectations.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这阵容确实够怪的。不过也基本在我的意料之中。

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} always prided myself as an innocent ball of spirituality and goodness. I’m sure it’s no surprise to see me spending what little free time I have getting closer to the lord.
lines.zh: : 我{i}一直{/i}以自己是个灵性与善良结成的小球为荣。我拿那点少得可怜的空闲时间来亲近主，你们看到我大概也不意外吧。

lines.en: : If you do anything to get closer to the lord, it’s probably just to have sex with him.
lines.zh: : 你要是真做了什么「亲近主」的事，那大概就是跟他上床。

lines.en: : Or her.
lines.zh: : 或者她。

lines.en: : Or them.
lines.zh: : 或者祂们。

lines.en: : Or anything, really. I can’t help but spread my legs at the first scent of divinity.
lines.zh: : 或者随便什么，真的。一闻到神性的味儿，我就忍不住张开腿。

lines.en: : If you two are here to make a mockery of Yasu’s religion, please just leave. She is sacrificing a great deal to make such a gathering possible and the least you could do is show her some respect.
lines.zh: : 如果你们俩是来拿 Yasu 的信仰开玩笑的，请出去。她为了让这场聚会能办成牺牲了很多，你们至少该给她一点尊重。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation7
: Respect is my second specialty, just after virtue. I am simply here to learn. Though I {i}do{/i} have a third specialty that I’m hesitant to reveal in church.
lines.zh: : 尊重是我的第二专长，仅次于贞洁。我只是来学习的。不过我{i}还{/i}有第三专长，在教堂里我不太好意思亮出来。

lines.en: : Are you really...in trouble with your god for letting us inside?...
lines.zh: : 你真的……因为放我们进来，惹上你神的麻烦了吗？……

lines.en: : While no words have found me to suggest such a thing, there is a pit He has planted in my stomach that is now beginning to sprout.
lines.zh: : 虽然没有话语降临告诉我确有此事，但祂在我胃里种下的一颗种子，如今已开始发芽。

lines.en: : And each of its branches as they grow through and around my insides serves as a painful reminder that I must remain where I belong in the machine.
lines.zh: : 它的每一根枝条穿透、缠绕我的内脏生长，都痛苦地提醒我：我必须留在机器上属于我的那个位置。

lines.en: : That I am nothing more than a cog...and that adding unwanted parts to that machine will sooner damage it than cause it to better perform its function.
lines.zh: : 我不过是一个齿轮……而给这台机器加上多余的零件，与其说会让它运转得更好，不如说只会更快把它弄坏。

lines.en: : Are you actually interested in this, Sana? It’s not your first time talking about this with Yasu, right?
lines.zh: : 你真对这个感兴趣吗，Sana？你跟 Yasu 聊这些不是第一次了吧？

lines.en: scene yasupresentation8
: Right...
: I’m a little more...familiar with Yasu’s beliefs than most people, but...there’s still a lot I don’t know...And I guess I {i}am{/i} a little interested...But I mostly just want to support her...
lines.zh: : 我比大多数人……更熟悉 Yasu 的信仰一点，不过……还{i}是{/i}有很多我不知道的……而且我大概是有点兴趣……但我主要只是想支持她……

lines.en: : I see that you, too, are a lady of the cloth?
lines.zh: : 看来你也是一位神职中人？

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t know if I’d go {i}that{/i} far...
lines.zh: : 我意思是……我也不知道有没有到{i}那个{/i}程度……

lines.en: scene yasupresentation9
: {b}ENOUGH! YOU EXIST IN HIS SHADOW AND BATHE IN HIS GLORY, YET JEST WHEN THE FRUITS OF TORMENT COULD BE PLUCKED FROM YOUR TREES AT ANY GIVEN-{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}够了！你们活在祂的阴影里，沐浴在祂的荣光里，却在痛苦之果随时可能从你们的树上被摘下时还要说笑——{/b}

lines.en: scene yasupresentation10
: Please keep your voices low so as to not disturb the rest of the clergy. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请各位压低声音，不要打扰到其余的神职人员。谢谢。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation11
: I understand that the light of the moon may be influencing your words and thoughts, but it is {i}very important{/i} to rid yourselves of such contaminants within the walls of my Lord’s only home.
lines.zh: : 我理解月光或许在影响你们的言辞与思绪，但在我主唯一的居所之内，把这类污染物清除掉{i}非常重要{/i}。

lines.en: : Now go ahead and tell them why your lord’s home is so important to you, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 那就接着告诉他们，为什么你主的居所对你这么重要，Yasu。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation10
: It’s important because I only exist when I’m inside of this church. Just as {i}you{/i} only exist when wallowing in sin because that is all you know how to do.
lines.zh: : 它重要，是因为只有在这座教堂里，我才存在。就像{i}你们{/i}只有在罪里打滚时才存在，因为那是你们唯一会做的事。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation4
: {b}BUT I WILL TEACH YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE PURE!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}但我会教你们什么叫纯洁！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}I WILL TEACH YOU HOW IT FEELS TO BASK IN THE ALL-CONSUMING SUN! HOW THE SCORCHING OF GUILT CAN SET ONE’S MIND ABLAZE.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我会教你们沐浴在那吞噬一切的太阳下是什么感觉！愧疚的灼烧怎样让一个人的心智熊熊燃起！{/b}

lines.en: scene yasupresentation11
: Please pay attention.
lines.zh: : 请注意听讲。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation12
: Zachariel (the first) said to those who doubted his presence on the planet, “We are all but fodder once the sky turns red.”
lines.zh: : Zachariel（初代）曾对那些怀疑他降临这颗星球的人说：「等天空变红，我们都不过是饲料。」

lines.en: : The others looked at him and laughed.
lines.zh: : 其他人看着他，笑了。

lines.en: : They doubted a day would come when the white-soaked skies would douse the gas giant that only they could walk upon the deepest of crimsons.
lines.zh: : 他们不信会有那么一天：被白色浸透的天空，会浇灭那颗气态巨行星——只有他们能在上面行走的、那一层最深的绯红。

lines.en: : They danced and they danced, hands caked in flour while the archangel swam deep through the gas to never be seen again.
lines.zh: : 他们跳啊跳啊，双手沾满面粉，而那位大天使则深深游进气体里，再也没出现过。

lines.en: : {b}SUCH FOOLS THEY WERE, THE LOT OF THEM! SUCH INSOLENCE AND COMPLACENCY IN THE FACE OF CERTAIN DOOM!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}他们这群人，真是一群蠢货！在注定的末日面前，如此傲慢，如此自满！{/b}

lines.en: : Zachariel emerged on the other side and gazed back at his origin point- which had gone up in flames so extravagant that he could see it from aeons away. But he did not smile, no. He cried.
lines.zh: : Zachariel 从另一侧浮出，回头望向自己的原点——那地方已燃起冲天大火，远在万古之外的他都能看见。但他没有笑，不。他哭了。

lines.en: : His tears would pool up in his hands, clasped left over right so the dominant one would act as the ladle when the time came to drink their guilt.
lines.zh: : 他的泪水在手中积成一小洼，左手扣在右手之上，好让惯用的那只在该啜饮他们的罪孽时充当勺子。

lines.en: : That time came once the fire went out. And while their sin was erased, they paid the ultimate price. But it all could have been avoided had they only {i}listened.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那一刻在火熄灭后到来了。虽然他们的罪被抹去了，却付出了终极的代价。但只要他们当初{i}肯听{/i}，这一切本可以避免。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation13
: The light of the sun is meant to be absorbed, while the light of the moon is meant to be abhorred.
lines.zh: : 太阳的光是用来吸收的，而月亮的光是应当憎恶的。

lines.en: : Douse yourself in the blackest of blacks and take the light into your own body...lest there will be some who will attempt to take it for themselves.
lines.zh: : 把自己浸在最深最深的黑里，把光纳入自己的身体……否则就会有人试图把光据为己有。

lines.en: : This is recycling in its purest form. You are to become the world — and in becoming the world, you are becoming one with Him.
lines.zh: : 这是最纯粹形态的循环利用。你要成为世界——而在成为世界的过程中，你就在与祂合一。

lines.en: : You may trade this light in for wonderful things. {i}Beautiful{/i} things. And there is not a single one you’ll be forced to leave behind you when your time has come to move to the hidden plane.
lines.zh: : 你可以拿这光去换美妙的东西。{i}美丽{/i}的东西。而当时辰到了、你要迁往那隐秘位面时，其中没有一样会被迫留在身后。

lines.en: : May I ask a question?
lines.zh: : 我可以问个问题吗？

lines.en: : Of course! I carry with me His unrivaled knowledge and will do anything I can to share it with you.
lines.zh: : 当然！我带着祂无可比拟的知识，会尽我所能与你分享。

lines.en: : Then, what exactly is this “hidden plane” you're referring to?
lines.zh: : 那么，你所说的「隐秘位面」到底是什么？

lines.en: : Are you actually curious, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你是真的好奇吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : I’m always curious. That’s who I am. There’s no point to life at all if you stop asking questions.
lines.zh: : 我一直都好奇。我就是这样的人。要是不再提问，人生就毫无意义了。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation1
: Another layer...where those who depart this one roam once their time has come to an end.
lines.zh: : 另一层……离开这一层的人，时辰到了之后会在那里游荡。

lines.en: : Some believe in Heaven or Hell...others believe in reincarnation...and many believe in pure darkness. But all of these things are wrong.
lines.zh: : 有人信天堂或地狱……有人信轮回转世……还有很多人信纯粹的黑暗。但这些全都是错的。

lines.en: : There is no “afterlife” for life itself never ends, meaning there is nothing to come {i}after{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 并没有「来世」这回事，因为生命本身永不终结，也就没有什么能排在它{i}后面{/i}。

lines.en: : His teachings tell us that we become observers once we’ve completed our mission here. And that those we leave behind take up the mantle from that point on.
lines.zh: : 祂的教诲告诉我们：完成此地的使命后，我们会成为观察者。而我们留下的人，从那时起接过衣钵。

lines.en: : This will go on and on and on until there is no one left.
lines.zh: : 这将一直持续下去，直到一个人都不剩。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation14
: What happens when there’s no one left?...
lines.zh: : 一个人都不剩的时候会怎样？……

lines.en: : He hasn’t told me yet. But if I had to guess...
lines.zh: : 祂还没告诉我。不过要我猜的话……

lines.en: : I imagine we’d all move somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 我想，我们全会搬到别的地方去。

lines.en: : {i}Another{/i} plane.
lines.zh: : {i}另一个{/i}位面。

lines.en: scene yasupresentation15
: Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} how it works?...
lines.zh: : 是{i}这样{/i}运作的吗？……

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} the missing piece?...
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是缺失的那块吗？……

lines.en: : Are you...actually being swayed by Yasu’s speech?
lines.zh: : 你……真被 Yasu 那番话打动了？

lines.en: : Her what? Oh, no. No, this is something else. This is a different thing. A thing you wouldn’t get. A thing none of you will ever get. But I have to get it because she got it. And if she got it, it means I can get it. Get it?
lines.zh: : 她的什么？哦，不。不是，这是另一回事。这是另一件事。一件你们不会懂的事。一件你们谁都不会懂的事。但我必须搞懂它，因为她搞懂了。而既然她能搞懂，就说明我也能。懂吗？

lines.en: scene yasupresentation16

: That can’t be it. No. Something else. It’s something else. I can’t wait that long. And there was no mention of how many others there would be. There has to be another way. Something else. But what? How? {i}Who?{/i}
lines.zh: : 不可能只是那样。不。是别的。是别的东西。我等不了那么久。而且根本没提还会有多少其他人。一定有别的办法。别的什么。可是什么？怎么办？是{i}谁{/i}？

lines.en: scene yasupresentation17
Nodoka rants to herself for a moment, bringing her voice to such a broken whisper that I can’t make any of her words out even though I’m sitting right next to her.
lines.zh: Nodoka 自顾自地念叨了一会儿，声音低成破碎的耳语，我就坐在她旁边，也一个字都听不清。

lines.en: Sana begins to bite her nails. She’s feeling nervous. I can tell.
lines.zh: Sana 开始咬指甲。她在紧张。我看得出来。

lines.en: She’s been kicking my leg periodically throughout the presentation, but I think she just wants to fuck me in one of the pews.
lines.zh: 整场宣讲她都在时不时踢我的腿，但我觉得她只是想在某条长椅上跟我做爱。

lines.en: Maybe she’s turned on by the idea of God watching her narrow crevice violated by His favorite son.
lines.zh: 也许一想到上帝正看着她那道狭窄的缝隙被祂最宠爱的儿子侵犯，她就兴奋了。

lines.en: Touka’s normal. Unswayed and unmoved after developing some sort of immunity to Yasu’s evangelical tendencies.
lines.zh: Touka 很正常。对 Yasu 那套布道已经产生了某种免疫力，不为所动。

lines.en: But now that she’s entered the monologue, {i}I’m{/i} thinking of fucking {i}her{/i} in one of the pews.
lines.zh: 可既然她进了独白模式，{i}我{/i}现在想的是在某条长椅上和{i}她{/i}做爱。

lines.en: Can I convert for just the evening? Reap the benefits of unprotected sex in the name of the lord before lopping off my wings and becoming a heretic?
lines.zh: 我能不能只皈依一个晚上？以主之名享受无套性爱的好处，然后再砍掉翅膀、变成异端？

lines.en: Would their flesh taste as sweet to a fallen angel? Or would my tongue die along with my wings since {b}THAT{/b} has been the tool I’ve used to fly more frequently.
lines.zh: 对堕落天使来说，她们的肉体尝起来还会一样甜吗？还是说我的舌头会和翅膀一起死去——毕竟{b}那{/b}才是我更常用来「飞」的工具。

lines.en: Meanwhile, Yasu-
lines.zh: 与此同时，Yasu——

lines.en: Yasu.
lines.zh: Yasu。

lines.en: She is floating.
lines.zh: 她在飘。

lines.en: That’s where my wings have gone. They’ve been given to her.
lines.zh: 我的翅膀就是去了那里。它们被给了她。

lines.en: She’s got my tongue too. She holds it in her hand and drives a stake into the lower right quadrant of it. The sensation latches onto my gums as they’re all I have left now.
lines.zh: 她还拿走了我的舌头。她把它握在手里，把一根木桩钉进它的右下象限。那感觉咬住了我的牙龈，因为如今我剩下的只有它们了。

lines.en: “68 65 20 69 73 20 69 6e 20 74 68 65 20 72 6f 6f 6d 20 77 69 74 68 20 75 73” she speaks, not knowing that his departure is imminent — for the door swings open and in walks-
lines.zh: “68 65 20 69 73 20 69 6e 20 74 68 65 20 72 6f 6f 6d 20 77 69 74 68 20 75 73”(他与我们同在这间屋子里)她说道，并不知道他的离去已近在眼前——因为门被推开，走进来的是——

lines.en: scene yasupresentation18
Kaori?
lines.zh: Kaori？

lines.en: : Oh! Another visitor! Such a pleasant surprise! Please do not touch the pews for you will only contaminate them. I will fetch you an extra chair from the-
lines.zh: : 哦！又一位访客！真是意外的惊喜！请不要碰那些长椅，你们只会弄脏它们。我去给您再搬一把椅子来——

lines.en: : What is this place?
lines.zh: : 这是什么地方？

lines.en: : This is New Hope Cathedral — home of The Creator. And I am but a humble messenger here to spread His word.
lines.zh: : 这里是新希望大教堂——造物主的居所。而我只是个卑微的使者，来传播祂的话语。

lines.en: : Kaori, what are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene yasupresentation19
: Friendburger?!
lines.zh: : 朋友汉堡？！

lines.en: : You know her, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你认识她，Sensei？

lines.en: : I...do too...
lines.zh: : 我……也认识……

lines.en: : And the mini Sara is here as well?! What is giving?!
lines.zh: : 迷你 Sara 也在这儿？！这是搞什么？！

lines.en: : Did you...get a flier too, Kaori?...
lines.zh: : 你……也收到传单了吗，Kaori？……

lines.en: : Flier?
lines.zh: : 传单？

lines.en: : Uhh...word-paper?
lines.zh: : 呃……文字纸？

lines.en: : No word-paper was received. I am inside of this place because I thought I would find a fluffy friend here. But I have found a Friend and he is not fluffy. Why will you not grow fur for me to pet, Burgerman?
lines.zh: : 没有收到文字纸。我进到这里，是因为我以为能在这儿找到一只毛茸茸的朋友。可我找到的是一位朋友，而他并不毛茸茸。你为什么不肯长出毛来让我摸，汉堡人？

lines.en: scene yasupresentation20
: Can you spare a minute of your time to learn about our lord and savior?
lines.zh: : 能耽误你一分钟，了解一下我们的主和救主吗？

lines.en: : Savior? Is there danger to be feared?
lines.zh: : 救主？有什么危险需要害怕吗？

lines.en: : Are you not here to seek salvation?
lines.zh: : 你不是来寻求救赎的吗？

lines.en: : I am here to seek fluff.
lines.zh: : 我是来寻求毛的。

lines.en: : That is why you {i}think{/i} you are here...but the truth is that this is no coincidence at all.
lines.zh: : 你{i}以为{/i}自己是为这个来的……但真相是，这根本不是巧合。

lines.en: : You have wandered into a home for the holy because you want to be closer to Him.
lines.zh: : 你走进了一座圣者的家，因为你想离祂更近。

lines.en: : Which Him? Friendburger? Because he has already been inside of my human mouth and I do not know how much closer we can become.
lines.zh: : 哪个祂？朋友汉堡吗？因为他已经进过我的人类口腔了，我不知道我们还能更近到哪儿去。

lines.en: : Sensei...really?
lines.zh: : Sensei……真的假的？

lines.en: : Okay, that one wasn’t my fault.
lines.zh: : 好，这次真不怪我。

lines.en: : Ugh...at least this one is an adult.
lines.zh: : 唉……至少这位是个成年人。

lines.en: : Him as in God.
lines.zh: : 是上帝的那个祂。

lines.en: : Friendburger is God?
lines.zh: : 朋友汉堡是上帝？

lines.en: : {i}God{/i} is God. And if you were able to open the door, it means He wants to meet you. He wants to-
lines.zh: : {i}上帝{/i}就是上帝。既然你能打开这扇门，就说明祂想见你。祂想——

lines.en: scene yasupresentation21
: If your sentence is complete, you are supposed to say “period” perio-
lines.zh: : 如果你的句子说完了，你应该说「句号」，句——

lines.en: scene yasupresentation22
: Wha-
: Y-Yasu! Have you gone mad?! You can’t just grope strangers like that!
lines.zh: : Y-Yasu！你疯了吗？！你不能就这么对陌生人动手动脚！

lines.en: : Help! I am having the sex!
lines.zh: : 救命！我在被做爱！

lines.en: : There’s something here. It’s-
lines.zh: : 这里有东西。它是——

lines.en: scene yasupresentation23

lines.zh: : 它是……

lines.en: : The female body?
lines.zh: : 女性的身体？

lines.en: : It’s...{i}familiar...{/i}
lines.zh: : 它是……{i}熟悉的……{/i}

lines.en: : And so...
lines.zh: : 于是……
: 所以……

lines.en: : Non-consensual?!
lines.zh: : 未经同意？！

lines.en: : {i}Angry...{/i}
: Maybe that has...something to do with the fact that you’re...you know...
lines.zh: : 也许那跟……你在……你知道的……有点关系

: There is nothing I can do for you.
lines.zh: : 我帮不了你。

lines.en: : Not yet.
lines.zh: : 还不是时候。

lines.en: scene black
: Y...Yasu! Apologize to the nice woman for violating her personal space! That was extremely inappropriate!
lines.zh: : Y……Yasu！向这位女士道歉，你侵犯了她的私人空间！这非常不合适！

lines.en: : Friendburger, what have you taught these small humans and why must they practice on my body?!
lines.zh: : 朋友汉堡，你都教了这些小人类些什么，为什么他们非得拿我的身体来练手？！

lines.en: : Again, this one isn’t on me. But I don’t blame you all for immediately suspecting me for things like this based on my prior actions and can promise I’m only a little bit offended.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这次不怪我。不过我不怪你们因为我的前科而立刻怀疑我，而且我可以保证，我只受了一点点冒犯。

lines.en: : My glove...it’s filthy...it must be washed...immediately...
lines.zh: : 我的手套……它脏了……必须洗……立刻……

lines.en: : Okay, well I have work tonight, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，我今晚还得上班，所以……

lines.en: : Yes, I believe now is as good a time as any to- Nodoka! Snap out of it!
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得现在正是时候——Nodoka！醒醒！

lines.en: : Don’t interrupt! I’m thinking!
lines.zh: : 别打断！我在想事情！

lines.en: : Okay...on behalf of Yasu and “He Who...Does Stuff,” I am ending this meeting.
lines.zh: : 好……我代表 Yasu 和「那个谁……做事情的那位」，宣布本次聚会结束。

lines.en: : Thank you all for coming and, to the woman in black, please accept my sincerest apologies on behalf of my friend. She doesn’t know any better and-
lines.zh: : 感谢各位到来；还有，对那位黑衣女士，请接受我代表我朋友致以最诚挚的歉意。她不懂事，而且——

lines.en: : Wait, where did she go?
lines.zh: : 等等，她去哪儿了？
